incident-bot: :rotating_light: page fired for service=latency-service-prod region=us-west alert=p99_slo_burn (p99 > 2.5s for 6m). PagerDuty incident PD-1234 created and notified on-call.

pagerduty: Auto-escalation to rotation: oncall@eng-oncall. Incident PD-1234. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/PD-1234

maria: acked. I'm awake and taking first look. tagging @raj @kevin. Any initial customer impact?

raj: seeing elevated tail in us-west only. p95 ~ 700ms -> 1.6s, p99 -> 3.1s. Error rates low, 5xx not rising. Looks like KV-cache eviction thrash + queueing on sidecars.

kevin: on it. I'll check autoscaler and recent deploys. rolling back last canary isn't ideal until we confirm cause. Runbook: https://wiki/internal/runbooks/latency-tail.md

maria: ok prioritize mitigation: 1) enable regional fallback routing to eu-west for non-auth calls, 2) scale up dedicated pool by +2 nodes (temp), 3) throttle low-priority traffic (batch jobs) at ingress.

raj: starting KV metrics query now. command: `kubectl logs svc/kv-proxy -n prod | grep eviction | tail -n 200`

raj: metrics show ~45k eviction events over last 5m, KV cache miss ratio spike. Also CPU on sidecar-proxy pods at 95%. Suspect small hotkeys + aggressive eviction policy.

kevin: issuing scale up: `redwood infra scale --pool gpu-dedicated-usw --replicas +2` -> tracking. Also enabling fallback: `cfg set routing.us-west.fallthrough=eu-west` (temp).

maria: :thumbsup: after scale up completes, let's monitor p99 trend. I want a customer impact callout. Any major customers hitting errors or just latency?

raj: no 5xx but slow responses for large-context requests from customers alpha-corp and beta-inc. Support notified with high-priority note. I'll DM support with sample traces.

kevin: scale up succeeded, sidecar CPU down to 70% across pods. p99 dropped to 1.9s after 90s. Still above target but improving.

maria: great. keep throttles in place for noncritical flows. @raj collect top 10 hotkeys and we can add k/v pinning if needed. I'll stay on this for next 20m then handoff to @kevin for follow-up.

raj: pulling hotkeys now. top keys: ["user:session:hotid", "doc:embed:xyz"] — creating eviction whitelist patch.

incident-bot: PD-1234: acknowledged by maria. Escalation timer paused. Next reminder in 15m.

kevin: taking 1st oncall after maria. will continue mitigation and coordinate with infra for a safer config change. If p99 stays >2s at next check, we'll open a rollback window.

maria: handing off. Thanks team. Will update the incident doc. Final note: customer-impact = latency (degraded UX) for alpha-corp and beta-inc, no data loss.

pagerduty: PD-1234 status: acknowledged by maria, reassigned to kevin for follow-up.

kevin: copying runbook steps into incident doc and leaving action items. monitoring 5m windows.

maria: :white_check_mark: closing initial triage loop. leave notes in PD-1234 and incident slack thread.
